description: This file defines a PHP class TimeConfigPeriodModel implementing a Normalizable interface, used for serializing TimeConfigPeriod objects into arrays with a focus on the 'startDay' property, for API responses within the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing TimeConfigPeriod objects for API responses, exposing the startDay property.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a TimeConfigPeriod object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the TimeConfigPeriod object into an array containing the startDay property.
